buildCommand: if [ -f scripts/vercel-install.mjs ]; then corepack yarn turbo build --filter=@noobstore/web; else corepack yarn --cwd ../.. turbo build --filter=@noobstore/web; fi
installCommand: if [ -f scripts/vercel-install.mjs ]; then node scripts/vercel-install.mjs; else node ../../scripts/vercel-install.mjs; fi
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PROVIDER" ]; then echo 'Skipping git-triggered production build: production deploys run through the deploy-production workflow.'; exit 0; fi; npx turbo-ignore --fallback=HEAD^1
